# The events

<!-- Generated by tools/docgen/generate.py --events-md from include/wxl/events/Events.def: edit the table. -->

Every event the core raises, by id. The ids and the args structs are the ABI: rows are only appended. The
args are in `wxl/events/*Args.hpp`. `On<Tag>(handler)` takes the tag and hands the handler the args;
the Extension virtual of the event's name gets them unpacked (`wxl/Overrides.def`). See
[Listen to an event](listen-to-an-event.md).

| Id | Event | Args | Tag | Raised when |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | `OnFrame` | `FrameArgs` | `Frame` | Once per frame, before Present. |
| 1 | `OnEndScene` | `EndSceneArgs` | `EndScene` | End of the frame, before Present. |
| 2 | `OnDeviceLost` | `DeviceResetArgs` | `DeviceLost` | Before IDirect3DDevice9::Reset frees the D3DPOOL_DEFAULT resources. |
| 3 | `OnDeviceReset` | `DeviceResetArgs` | `DeviceReset` | After a successful IDirect3DDevice9::Reset. |
| 4 | `OnUpdate` | `UpdateArgs` | `Update` | Once per frame, the logic tick, with the frame delta. |
| 5 | `OnWorldRender` | `WorldRenderArgs` | `WorldRender` | The world draw pass starts. |
| 6 | `OnWorldRenderEnd` | `WorldRenderEndArgs` | `WorldRenderEnd` | The world is drawn and the interface is not yet: the post-process slot, in screen space. |
| 7 | `OnWorldSceneEnd` | `WorldSceneEndArgs` | `WorldSceneEnd` | The world is drawn and the camera matrices that drew it are still on the device. |
| 8 | `OnLiquidRender` | `LiquidRenderArgs` | `LiquidRender` | A liquid render pass is about to draw. |
| 9 | `OnInput` | `InputArgs` | `Input` | A window message arrived; a handler may swallow it. |
| 10 | `OnWorldClick` | `WorldClickArgs` | `WorldClick` | A mouse click resolved to a point or an object in the world. |
| 11 | `OnWmoRootLoad` | `WmoRootLoadArgs` | `WmoRootLoad` | A WMO root buffer is read, before the native chunk walk. |
| 12 | `OnWmoGroupLoad` | `WmoGroupLoadArgs` | `WmoGroupLoad` | A WMO group buffer is read, before the native sub-chunk walk. |
| 13 | `OnTextureUpload` | `TextureUploadArgs` | `TextureUpload` | A texture is about to upload to the device. |
| 14 | `OnBlpLoad` | `BlpLoadArgs` | `BlpLoad` | A BLP texture was requested by name; fires on every reference, cached or not. |
| 15 | `OnObjectUpdate` | `ObjectUpdateArgs` | `ObjectUpdate` | A server object create/update batch was parsed. |
| 16 | `OnObjectDestroy` | `ObjectDestroyArgs` | `ObjectDestroy` | An object is about to despawn; it is still resident. |
| 17 | `OnTargetChanged` | `TargetChangedArgs` | `TargetChanged` | The target-set API applied a new target. |
| 18 | `OnSoundPlay` | `SoundPlayArgs` | `SoundPlay` | A UI or world sound is about to play. |
| 19 | `OnDoodadSpawn` | `DoodadSpawnArgs` | `DoodadSpawn` | A placed map doodad was built. |
| 20 | `OnItemSlotChange` | `ItemSlotChangeArgs` | `ItemSlotChange` | A character model slot received an item. |
| 21 | `OnItemSlotClear` | `ItemSlotClearArgs` | `ItemSlotClear` | A character model equipment slot was cleared. |
| 22 | `OnWorldEnter` | `WorldEnterArgs` | `WorldEnter` | The world finished loading; the player is in-world. |
| 23 | `OnWorldLeave` | `WorldLeaveArgs` | `WorldLeave` | The world is being torn down; the map being left is still loaded. |
| 24 | `OnSettingChanged` | `SettingChangedArgs` | `SettingChanged` | A setting changed: from /wxl set, the settings panel, a profile, or Set (wxl/Settings.hpp). |
| 25 | `OnExtensionsLoaded` | `ExtensionsLoadedArgs` | `ExtensionsLoaded` | Every extension has loaded: look up other extensions' services here. Once, before the first frame. |
| 26 | `OnObjectAdded` | `ObjectLifeArgs` | `ObjectAdded` | An object joined the client's object manager: created, or back in view. Its handle is new. |
| 27 | `OnObjectRemoved` | `ObjectLifeArgs` | `ObjectRemoved` | An object left the object manager (out of view, destroyed, world torn down); its handle expires after. |
| 28 | `OnUnitDamage` | `UnitDamageArgs` | `UnitDamage` | The combat log took a damage entry: melee, spell, periodic, split, damage shield or environment. |
| 29 | `OnUnitDeath` | `UnitDeathArgs` | `UnitDeath` | The client ran a unit's death: its health reached zero, the dead flag was set, or it was removed dead. |
| 30 | `OnUnitNameChanged` | `UnitNameArgs` | `UnitNameChanged` | The name the client shows for a resident unit changed (the server answered a name query, a title...). |
| 31 | `OnChatMessage` | `ChatMessageArgs` | `ChatMessage` | A server chat line passed the client's filters and is about to be shown. |
